## Notes

- **`temporal`** changes the Docker base image: Temporal's native core ships
  glibc builds only and won't load on Alpine, even with `gcompat`, so the image
  builds on `node:24-bookworm-slim` instead of the Alpine house image. The
  `browser` and `pm2` steps have Debian equivalents.
- **`browser`** adds Chromium to the image, roughly 800 MB. `launchBrowser()`
  in `src/utils/browser.ts` isn't called anywhere by default.
- **`pm2`** runs `dist/` with `autorestart: false`: a crash is not restarted by
  PM2. Rely on your container's restart policy, or change it.
- **`queue`** off leaves a worker that only runs Temporal workflows (or nothing,
  as a base for your own loop).
